description: This file defines custom exception classes related to data availability and cache fullness within the Orleans.Streams namespace. It includes two serializable exception classes, DataNotAvailableException and CacheFullException, each inheriting from OrleansException, with relevant constructors for various initialization scenarios.

classes.name: DataNotAvailableException
classes.description: An exception indicating that the requested data is not available.

classes.name: CacheFullException
classes.description: An exception indicating that the queue message cache is full.

methods.name: DataNotAvailableException()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the exception with a default message 'Data not found'.

methods.name: DataNotAvailableException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a custom message.

methods.name: DataNotAvailableException(string message, Exception inner)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a custom message and an inner exception.

methods.name: CacheFullException()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the exception with a default message 'Queue message cache is full'.

methods.name: CacheFullException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a custom message.

methods.name: CacheFullException(string message, Exception inner)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a custom message and an inner exception.
